name: Krakow
summary: Krakow combines one of the best-preserved medieval squares in Europe with a remarkably low cost of living and a rapidly growing nomadic community. Its historic center, declared a World Heritage Site, coexists with a growing ecosystem of specialty cafes and coworking spaces, especially in the Kazimierz and Stare Miasto neighborhoods.
